Chart spend by nesting

Source: R/charts.R
ec_sunburst.Rd

A sunburst, one ring per level: the plan's own line items in the inner ring, and any cell backed by a subplan opening into that subplan's line items further out. A cell nobody has attached anything beneath is a leaf.

Usage

ec_sunburst(x, theme = "light")

Arguments

x

A MediaPlan.

theme

A viz_theme() name or override list.

Value

A new_spec() of kind "sunburst".

Details

This is the shape of the plan's money, where ec_tree() is the shape of its ownership. Branch colours match ec_tree() and ec_ownership().

Unlike the other builders this one needs the MediaPlan itself — it walks into the subplans to build each ring, which no single projection carries.

See also

ec_tree(), ec_rollup()

Examples

topline <- mediaplanr::media_plan_from_df(
  data.frame(week = as.Date("2026-07-06"), channel = c("TV", "Search"),
             planned_spend = c(100, 40)),
  grain = "channel", time = "week", name = "Q3 topline"
)
tv <- mediaplanr::media_plan_from_df(
  data.frame(week = as.Date("2026-07-06"), channel = "TV",
             partner = c("NBC", "ESPN"),
             planned_spend = c(70, 50)),
  grain = c("channel", "partner"), time = "week", name = "TV detail"
)
ec_sunburst(mediaplanr::attach_subplan(topline, tv))
#> <mediaplanr_spec> sunburst
#>   from    the plan tree
#>   series  1
#>   size    1,766 bytes of JSON
#>   meta    owners
#> 
#>   as_widget() to draw it, as_json() to send it
